transcriptText:
Three streets, 350 behind. How do you get it all in? Stack to pot: 350 ÷ 100 = 3.5. Half the pot, each time. 50... 100... 200. All 350. The pot ends at 800.

Now the river, three spades out. 10 more are unseen... 45 ways to hold two. 9 use the A♠. And you hold it. His flushes drop to 36, and every nut flush is gone.

Say 60 pairs fold. An illustration. Without your ace, 57.1%. With it, 62.5%. A nudge, not a new range. Change the line, so only 30 pairs are left to fold. 40%... short of the 42.9% a 3/4-pot bluff needs. The ace lifts it to 45.5%. Barely. The line sets the range.

Your turn. Sort two bluff cards. The A♠ blocks his calls. Better bluff. The 9♦ blocks his folds. Worse bluff. Plan all three streets. Bluff with the card that blocks his calls. Up next: narrowing ranges.
